text:
Anya: saw a spike in duplicate token billing from streaming clients after yesterday's proxy rollout. ~200 extra token charges for some tenants.
Matt: ugh. observed that too. likely during reconnects — clients reconnect + server treats resume as new session sometimes.
Jia: logs show `resume_id` header missing on ~30% of reconnects to the new proxy before TLS re-key. snippet: `headers: { Authorization: ..., resume_id: null }`
Sam: is it the routing change that strips the resume header? we added a lightweight proxy in front of edge to terminate and forward.
Anya: preliminary trace shows request enters proxy with resume, exits without. sample: `inbound: resume=abc123` -> `upstream: resume=`.
Kiran: that explains duplicate billing — backend counts as new session and charges tokens from start, not resume.
Matt: can repro locally by toggling `strip_resume_header: true` in proxy config. repro steps I pushed to the test plan.
Anya: temporary mitigation: gate rollout and set proxy flag to preserve resume. OpsBot: rolling back canary from eu-west-1 to preserve customer traffic. :thumbsup:
Jia: console telemetry is bad here — we don't surface whether a reconnect used resume vs new session. visibility gap.
Sam: we should add an event `session.resume_status` with values `resumed`/`new` and include `resume_id` where available. cheap to emit from the runtime.
Kiran: agree. also add metric `resume_header_stripped` increment when proxy drops it. helps correlate to rollout.
Anya: quick fix = flip proxy flag, patch proxy to forward unknown headers, and ship runtime metric. follow-up = console card to show resumed % and a rollout indicator.
Matt: patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/422 (adds forwarding and tests). blocking: need infra signoff for canary rollback.
Jia: for postmortem UI: show per-tenant resumed rate, and alert when resumed_rate < 95% for >5m.
Sam: note: some clients fall back to fresh connection if resume_id stale, so we must dedupe billing on backend too. add server-side idempotency on resume token acceptance.
Kiran: adding server-side dedupe is safer but more invasive. timeline: patch proxy today, server dedupe in 2 weeks.
Anya: assigning owners: Matt -> proxy revert patch, Jia -> runtime telemetry + console card spec, Sam -> server dedupe design.
OpsBot: Started rollback canary in eu-west-1 at 12:17 UTC.
Matt: after rollback, duplicate charges dropped to baseline for affected tenants. confirming.
Jia: follow-up items: (1) telemetry + alert, (2) console resume widget, (3) server dedupe RFC, (4) add integration test catching header-preservation across proxies.
Anya: adding to backlog and SLO board. thanks all.
Kiran: small note — add unit test that simulates midstream TLS rekey; that was correlated with header loss in logs.
Matt: will add. shipping hotfix now. :rocket:
Anya: closing loop — will write incident blurb for all-hands and tag impacted customers.
